This role is with a photonics manufacturer headquartered in Merrimack County, New Hampshire, with additional operations in Massachusetts and New York. The company designs and manufactures light measurement systems, integrating spheres, reflectance materials, optical calibration solutions, specialty light sources, and custom precision optical systems used across aerospace and defense, remote sensing, semiconductor, automotive, LED and lighting, medical device, image sensor, and industrial photonic markets worldwide.
The company is in an active growth phase, expanding its portfolio and its reach into high-growth application markets. Product management is central to that growth: deciding where to invest, how to position a highly technical portfolio, and how to equip the sales team to win.

The Senior Product Manager owns one of the company's photonics, light measurement, or remote sensing product lines end to end, from product planning and roadmap through launch, growth, and phase out. This role translates market and application insight into differentiated solutions, prioritized product investments, and repeatable commercial growth across assigned markets.

The ideal candidate is an experienced hardware product manager who has done this at a company with established product management processes, and who can make complex technology easy to understand for customers and sales teams. • Own the strategy, roadmap, and full lifecycle of an assigned product line, from concept and launch through phase out

• Prioritize application opportunities based on market attractiveness, customer pain, capability fit, differentiation, repeatability, revenue and profit potential, and time to revenue

• Map assigned markets and value chains to identify where the company can participate and win

• Support pricing, positioning, and sales activity with datasheets, presentations, white papers, and webinars

• Develop and execute go-to-market plans and product launches with Sales and Marketing

• Define, analyze, and report product metrics to measure success and guide strategy

The role

You'll own performance across paid, email and SMS, and on-site, and make sure every dollar earns its keep. You'll also bring creative and channel thinking together, because on today's platforms the creative is the targeting.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set strategy, lead a small team and partners, and still be close enough to the numbers and the work to know what's really happening. Your first priorities are profitable performance marketing, building a clear, well-run team, and growing trade.

What you'll do

•
Own performance marketing. Set budgets and allocation across Google, Meta, affiliates, and other paid channels, with gross profit after variable costs as the measure of success.

•
Build marketing for our trade program. B2B is a strategic focus. Use our channels, content, and lifecycle programs to attract and retain high-value interior designers, architects, and hospitality clients, and partner with our B2B sales team.

•
Own the marketing budget and vendors. Manage the full marketing budget, plus vendor and partner contracts and renewals.

•
Bring creative and performance together. Build campaigns where creative testing drives results, and work with our creative team to brief, test, and learn.

•
Lead email, SMS, and lifecycle for both consumer and trade audiences, treating email as a performance channel as well as a content channel.

•
Own promotions with merchandising, within agreed margin guardrails.

•
Oversee organic social and reviews, including Instagram, Pinterest, and Trustpilot.

•
Run affiliates end to end, from partner performance to editorial and publisher relationships.

•
Build trusted measurement with finance and our data team, across channels and customer types.

•
Own go-to-market and the marketing calendar. Turn quarterly brand and trend direction from our Chief Brand Officer into a clear plan for launches, campaigns, and seasonal moments, and lead it from planning through execution with merchandising, creative, and our trade team.

•
Lead and shape the team. Manage and develop email and SMS, creative, copy, and agency partners, and shape the team as we grow, including whether and when to add roles.

About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Our engineering team owns the software that makes our marketplace work. We’re looking for an experienced leader to help lead teams focused on a core customer experience. Our customers look to Faire to help manage and run their wholesale business across the customer journey, from getting their products listed to marketing their business through promotions or email to processing wholesale orders and managing their fulfillment.

We care about good engineering practices and love to write software that is secure, tested, easy to maintain, and scalable to millions of users. We build minimum viable products, deploy to production multiple times per day, A/B test customer-facing changes, listen to the data, and iterate.

We are deeply committed to accelerating the adoption of AI across our engineering workflow-leveraging it for everything from basic coding assistance and streamlining review processes to informing architectural design and enhancing system monitoring. We are excited about this vision and are seeking Engineering Managers to partner with us in accelerating it, driving AI as a critical enabler for increasing our development velocity and system quality.

• Identify and scope infrastructure or tooling changes to impact efficiency and/or quality

• Directly manage a cross-functional team of engineers.

• Partner with product management and design on team strategy and roadmapping

• Lead scoping and sprint planning within your teams

• Dive into the architecture, designs and code in order to lead your team effectively. 

• Lead contributor and owner of process and team structure decisions.

• Directly impact our ability to grow quickly while improving operational efficiencies.

Qualifications

• A passion for programming and solving problems with code.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent industry experience.

• A strong technical background and you are still capable of using it every day. 

• A love for technology, and an insatiable curiosity for new tools to tackle real problems.

• A track record of leading teams to higher levels of contribution.

• A track record of assisting team members to achieve higher levels of impact in their careers.

• Capable and willing to write software for a couple months as part of your onboarding.

• Still willing and able to get your hands dirty with software design, code creation, tooling, etc.

• Postgraduate degree in management or business

• Strength and experience in running engineering teams using metrics

• Have lead through other managers
